scope: Menu crashes, responsive geometry, input focus, shared actions and task items

checks: Permission denial by Esc and default Enter; exact LSP request approved by click
One exact bash PTY call approved; live output before exit; human stdin delivered
Queued instruction is persisted after tool completion and answered
Compact initialization labels; file picker in empty project; Enter and l remain usable
Draft survives file picker and resize
Quit cancelled by mouse; theme opens correctly afterward
Selection is textual in NO_COLOR; source fixtures unchanged

regressions: Preset footer/outside clicks do not index a nonexistent item
Empty file list does not crash
File picker and argument form fit 60x20/80x24/120x36
Argument focus and session selection survive resize
Mouse keeps the modal instance; mode has no invisible search
Complete notes scroll and keep asynchronous probe results
Unsaved form can resume; conditional fields preserve hidden values
Environment pair editor rejects duplicate names
Contract list items preserve separators across reopen
Workspace mouse uses the rendered rows and breadcrumb offset
Mouse cannot retarget a contract item edit to another field
Resuming an unsaved form never reaccepts a cancelled probe result
review: Read-only independent review; actionable findings fixed with regression coverage
limitations: No new Codaro/Crush quality or latency benchmark
Provider test uses the installed local model; other provider APIs and real OAuth services were not called
PTY uses isolated HOME/workspace and a controlled noisy LSP fixture
Computed/component/VT checks do not certify every terminal or assistive technology
